capture.title: Add memory
capture.subtitle: Tell your AI something about yourself. It turns it into a fact or a guess that you check before saving.
capture.inputPlaceholder: e.g. I have morning meetings from 9 to 11 in Zagreb
capture.inputHint: Write one sentence. The preview updates while you type.
capture.example1: I have morning meetings from 9 to 11 in Zagreb
capture.example2: I usually drink coffee before work
capture.example3: I'm flying to Barcelona in May
capture.previewEmpty: Your preview appears here once you write a sentence.

typeHelp.fact: You said it, so it is saved as verified.
typeHelp.inference: A guess. It is saved unverified so you can confirm it later.

reason.category: Category chosen because of the word “{{word}}”.
reason.categoryDefault: No clear topic found, so it is filed under Preferences. Change it if needed.
reason.hedge: You wrote “{{word}}”, so this is treated as a guess.
reason.firstPerson: You said this about yourself, so it is treated as a fact.
reason.noFirstPerson: It is not clearly about you, so it is treated as a guess.

errors.paused: Memory saving is paused, so nothing was saved. You can turn it back on in Privacy.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Your text is still here, so try again.
errors.validation: Some details weren't accepted. Check the preview and try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong while saving. Try again.
